question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Surveillance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Surveillance"** means close observation, especially of a person or group considered suspicious. (निगरानी)
 
 
• **Example:** The police conducted surveillance to track the suspect's movements.
 
 
• **"Surveillance"** is correctly spelled and refers to the act of monitoring or watching over something or someone closely. (निगरानी)
 
 
• **Example:** CCTV cameras are used for surveillance in public areas to ensure safety.
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4 i.e. Surveillance.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Surveillance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Servillance **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "Surveillance."
 
 
• **Example:** Servillance is not a valid word.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Survailance **(गलत वर्तनी): This is another incorrect spelling of the word "Surveillance."
 
 
• **Example:** Survailance is a misspelled form of the correct word "Surveillance."
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Survilance **(गलत वर्तनी): This is yet another incorrect spelling of the word "Surveillance."
 
 
• **Example:** Survilance is not recognized as a correct word in English.
 
 
Q: Choose the correctly spelt word: 1) Servillance, 2) Survailance, 3) Survilance, 4) Surveillance 

The correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Surveillance**.
